project.name: Lambchop
project.purpose: Reusable Codex skill project for deploying autonomous coding teams into new or existing repositories.

work_items.title: Create autonomous coding team skill foundation
acceptance_criteria: Skill entrypoint exists with Codex skill frontmatter.
References cover setup interview, workflow architecture, work item model, automation prompt, SeeItAI lessons, proof of work, and validation.
Templates exist for workflow, state, progress, backoff, and environment config.
No user-facing Python setup flow is required.
implementation_notes: Initial setup was performed in the main checkout because the repository had no prior autonomous workflow or commits.
validation: non-template docs scanned clean for angle-bracket placeholders
skill and references include local-only safety defaults
work_items.next_step: Create the initial local commit, then continue with pressure-test validation.

work_items.title: Pressure-test empty repo autonomous setup
acceptance_criteria: A fresh empty repo scenario proves Codex inspects first and asks only missing product questions.
Generated workflow/state/progress/backoff files are complete and placeholder-free.
Progress records proof of setup and local-only safety defaults.
implementation_notes: Use a temporary local fixture repo or a fresh subagent scenario. Do not require the user to run scripts.
work_items.next_step: Run a validation scenario against an empty fixture repo and record proof.

work_items.title: Pressure-test existing repo autonomous setup
acceptance_criteria: An existing app/library repo scenario proves Codex infers stack, commands, and source-of-truth files before asking questions.
The setup updates or avoids duplicate automation when overlap exists.
State and progress capture evidence sufficient for a future automation run.
implementation_notes: Prefer a temporary fixture or a safe local sample. Do not mutate unrelated user projects without explicit instruction.
work_items.next_step: Run an existing-repo setup scenario and record proof.

work_items.title: Install and document local deployment of the skill
acceptance_criteria: The skill can be installed or linked into Codex skills for local use.
A target-project deployment checklist is recorded.
No Cursor or Claude Code requirements are added to v1.
implementation_notes: Keep deployment Codex-first. Cursor support is a later phase.
work_items.next_step: Install or link the skill after validation tasks pass.

last_run.summary: Initialized Lambchop as the autonomous coding team skill project, added a work queue for validation and local deployment, and created the Codex automation.
last_run.next_action: Commit the initialized workflow and skill project, then let automation continue with pressure-test validation.
